title: Grammy Winner Adele Meets Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson For The First Time [Watch]
htmlContent:
Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson and Adele met for the first time at the 2023 Grammys, and it was a moment to remember. The Rock, who has made a name for himself in Hollywood as one of the biggest action stars, was in attendance at the award show with his wife, Lauren Hashian. While on the red carpet, Johnson shared with Laverne Cox during E! Live, "I feel it; we feel the love."

"We love Beyoncé; we've got a Beyoncé household. Jay-Z. But Adele, too. She's amazing; I can't wait to see her."

The moment the two stars met was captured on camera and quickly went viral. Fans were excited to see the interaction between the two icons, and they were not disappointed. The Rock and Adele were all smiles as they chatted and posed for a photo together.

The Rock is no stranger to the entertainment industry. He has been a professional wrestler, a successful actor, and a producer. He is one of the most recognizable faces in the world and has a massive following on social media. Conversely, Adele is a Grammy-winning singer-songwriter who has taken the world by storm with her powerful voice and soulful songs.

Fans were thrilled to see The Rock and Adele together, and many took to social media to express their excitement. Some even speculated about the possibility of a collaboration between the two stars.

During the opening monologue of host Trevor Noah, Dwayne got his wish when he met the singer "Easy on Me" on live television, to his surprise as well. He even presented Adele with the Grammy for best pop solo performance in the show.

The 2023 Grammys was a night filled with incredible performances and memorable moments. The Rock and Adele meeting for the first time was just one of the many highlights of the night. The Rock continues to dominate the entertainment industry, and Adele continues to captivate audiences with her music. Fans are eager to see what the future holds for these two legends.
